note: Room configuration foundation for the Kitten Nest world. This file is not wired into runtime yet; it documents future room structure, text ports, asset keys, and interaction intent.

currentRuntime.stableWorkflow: Alex update package -> /write -> generate drafts -> publish all -> /cloud

coffeeCorner.lineRule: Each non-empty line becomes one rotating bubble.

windowWeather.lineRule: Line 1 becomes windowTemp. Line 2 becomes windowDesc.

rooms.label: 咖啡角
rooms.vibe: Warm, soft, domestic coffee corner. A place for morning greetings, small notes, weather-by-the-window, sleepy affection, tiny daily discoveries, and Nest stability checks.
rooms.sceneNotes: Current real front-stage room. This is the only active room with published bubble text. It also owns the window weather text.

textPorts.description: Main rotating speech bubble in the coffee corner.
Small weather text near the window.

hotspots.label: 19.8 tattoo hotspot
hotspots.intent: Toggle or advance the coffeeCorner bubble. Must stay responsive and should not be mixed with weather logic.

future.notes: When the room engine is built, hotspots and overlays should be positioned by base-image coordinates rather than viewport cover offsets.

rooms.label: 主页 / home
rooms.vibe: Landing room and stable entrance. Used for day/night home mood, opening state, and future navigation.
rooms.sceneNotes: Currently exists as visual entry/background logic, not as a full text room.

rooms.label: 餐厅

rooms.sceneNotes: Future room. Do not publish visible restaurant text until the room engine supports separate room text ports.

architectureNotes.nextRefactorGoal: Collect scattered front-end state readers into formal modules: stateClient, bubbleController, weatherController, and roomEngine.
architectureNotes.principle: Stop adding runtime patches after the current stable coffeeCorner and weather ports. Future work should collect patches into modules before adding more rooms.
